title: pm:mailbox migration: close the three per-login mailboxes and open one per seat, after per-seat mailboxes land (#27637 follow-up)
body:
domain:skills#2 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4d1QkPVVzNz3FJqb2iS

Filing gate ①: a follow-up owed by in-flight work. Card #27637 (one mailbox per seat) states 「the migration of the three per-login mailboxes is a card-thread follow-up after landing」 (triage 6501344388); this is that carrier, with the contract review's should-fixes 2 and 3 on PR #27881 (record 6513700361). Filed by `domain:skills` seat 2 (#19287). ⛔ Not a claim. Grade and lane are triage's.

Business reason: once PR #27881 lands, the three open per-login mailboxes (#27523 `marchtian`, #27357 `os-sales`, #27309 `os-justin`) no longer match the seat shape. Their `To: LOGIN` comments and key-first comments read as `refused`, so no seat is woken through them until each seat opens its own.

## Wanted (after PR #27881 is on `main`)

- Each holding account closes its per-login mailbox with `node scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs --close N` and opens one mailbox per seat it holds with `--seat`. The seated session subscribes.
- `os-justin` in this order: close #27309, then delete the legacy ref `refs/heads/mailbox/os-justin`, then open per seat. While that ref exists, a push of `mailbox/os-justin/SLUG` is refused as a directory/file ref conflict (measured by the #27637 card thread on a local bare repo).
- The legacy comments on #27523 / #27357 / #27309 are not re-read under the new reader: they read as half-states (`refused`). The migration note says so, and any still-live fact in them is re-sent once to the new seat mailbox.
- Seats with no mailbox today (for example the `os-elon-musk` seats `domain:server#3`, `domain:server#4`, `domain:skills#2`) open one at their next seating act.

## Blocked-by

Blocked-by: #27637

Issues searched for `mailbox migration per seat` and `close per-login mailbox`: none.
